title: protect workflow check-status logging: print checks sorted by STATE key order (failure first) and append ?pr=<number> to run attempt links
answers: Why does the protect check log list failing checks before pending or passing ones?
How do I add a new status to the protect.js check summary, and where does its print order come from?
Where is the workflow-run link in the PR check log built, and why does it carry a pr query parameter?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/protect.js:module.exports is the GitHub Actions script that polls a PR's check runs, builds the `checks` list (one entry per workflow run attempt, with name, url, status and pendingJobs), and prints one line per check with an icon, name and link.
Rule: Order is defined once by `STATE` (`failure`, `pending`, `success`, `skipped`) and derived as `STATUS_ORDER = Object.values(STATE)`; `checks.sort(...)` by `STATUS_ORDER.indexOf(status)` runs right before the logging `forEach`. Object.values keeps key insertion order, so reorder keys in `STATE` to change print priority, and add new statuses there rather than hard-coding a second list. Run-attempt URLs are built as `${run.html_url}/attempts/${run.run_attempt}?pr=${pullRequest.number}` in both places that push to `checks`; keep the `?pr=` suffix when adding another run link.
Constraints: The sort mutates `checks` in place and only affects logging order, not the status value that decides pass/fail. A status not present in `STATE` gets indexOf -1 and sorts before `failure`. Applies only to the protect.js check-logging path, not to other workflows.
applies: GitHub Actions protect.js check polling and logging in .github/workflows; applies to changes to check ordering or workflow-run link format.
says: Failed checks are buried beneath passing jobs in the protection status summary log.
Display failing jobs first in the pull request status check log.
Why does the pull request check output list failed workflows before passing ones?
Ensure workflow attempt links in the check summary include the pull request number.
search: In .github/workflows/protect.js:module.exports, check runs logged in the summary are sorted in place by STATUS_ORDER.indexOf(status) right before the logging loop, using STATUS_ORDER = Object.values(STATE) which prioritizes failure first. Run attempt URLs constructed across both push sites must append ?pr=${pullRequest.number} to ${run.html_url}/attempts/${run.run_attempt}. The sorting mutates checks in place for logging order only without affecting merge gating verdicts, and new statuses must be defined directly in STATE.
